content.query: SELECT CONCAT(STRING_AGG(''+CAST([FILE_NAME] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST([INSERT_DTTM] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(Metrics AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+'','') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM),'') FROM ( select *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY [FILE_NAME],[Metrics],[DATE] ORDER BY [INSERT_DTTM] DESC) RNK from [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL] WHERE --cast([Date] as DATE) = cast('2025-03-17' as DATE) --and SUBSTRING([FILE_NAME],7,3) = 'TRU' AND [Source] <> [Target] ) SRC_HASHLOG WHERE RNK=1 UPDATE [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL] SET [DATE]=cast('2025-03-17' as DATE) ,FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20240108','20250317') WHERE --cast([Date] as DATE) = cast('2025-03-17' as DATE) [Source] <> [Target] AND [DATE]=cast('2025-03-17' as DATE)
